hero.title: Find your
hero.description: A thoughtful space for growth, communication, and expression — for children and adults, at a pace and in a way that suits you.

about.lead: Hello, I’m Naama Kalish Reich, a speech-language pathologist.
about.description: I support children and adults through assessment and therapy in communication, language, speech, voice, and oral functions. Every person and family has a story of their own, so I begin by listening, understanding your needs, and thinking together about a next step.
about.link: Let’s see how I can help

services.description: Care is tailored to age, needs, and personal goals. In an introductory conversation, we can explore what may be right for you.
services.note: Information on this website is general and is not a substitute for an individual assessment or professional advice.

language.title: Language & communication
language.description: Understanding and expression, vocabulary, sentence building, and everyday communication.

speech.title: Speech & articulation
speech.description: Sound production, speech clarity, and confidence in conversation.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Voice use, voice quality, and healthy voice habits.

oral.title: Oral functions
oral.description: Assessment and support for oral functions, when appropriate.

approach.photoAlt: A therapy session with play and shared interaction
approach.description: A good process grows from connection, curiosity, and collaboration. Together, we set practical goals and look for ways to bring progress into everyday life — at home, in preschool, at school, and at work.

contact.description: Get in touch for an introductory conversation and we can explore together whether and how I may be able to help.
